title: CodeBuild Environment to Privilege Escalation
description: CodeBuild projects can have environment variables that contain credentials or reference Parameter Store secrets. An attacker who can trigger a build (or modify the build spec) injects code that exfiltrates these credentials during the build. The build runs with the CodeBuild service role, which may have iam:CreateAccessKey or other privileged permissions. The attacker uses the stolen credentials to create access keys or assume higher-privilege roles, completing the escalation.

steps.context: Create access keys with stolen permissions
